project.name: osgi/domains/incus/incus-ingress-contract
project.description: The HOST face of the incus contract — what BOTH realms genuinely consume. The GROW runs host-flat (outside Felix, com.pulumi lives there) yet is still the incus domain talking to itself across the realm boundary com.pulumi imposes: the scion (OSGi) PROJECTS an InstanceGrowPlan and the host GROW ACTUALISES it. type=dual-realm dual-realm, like seed-broker-codec: staged as a bundle OSGi-side AND kept flat host-side (the GROW fetches and decodes via the dual-realm codec). It carries the flat value views (InstanceGrowPlan + sub-views) AND the pure path logic both realms share (BootstrapPaths — the scion materialises into it, the host derives the instance mounts from it, so the plan needs no device view). Governance (dual-realm library rule): the red line is NOT "no logic" but "no dependency absent from either realm" — a type may carry pure logic here iff it depends only on the JDK + jspecify (no OSGi type, no other domain, no service reference) and is owned by this one domain. Legitimate and NOT a seam transgression — producer and consumer are the SAME domain (intra-domain dual-realm), orthogonal to the contract-purity guard. See docs/architecture/osgi/host-cellar-realisation-spec.adoc § the-grow-anatomy.
